instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Freight forwarding and customs brokerage firm managing sea, air, and road shipments for 200+ SME importers and exporters. Processing ~300 customs declarations monthly. Seeking to implement automated customs document classification and regulatory change monitoring across 15 trade corridors.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases.
answers.strategicGoals: Our industry is facing structural decline due to technological disruption and changing consumer behavior. We cannot rely on incremental improvements to our legacy business — we need to identify entirely new value propositions that leverage our brand, customer relationships, or operational capabilities in adjacent spaces where demand is growing, not shrinking.
answers.additionalContext: The firm currently faces pressure from major tech giants who are integrating logistics software directly into their supply chain solutions. Maintaining competitive edge requires both operational excellence and strategic market expansion.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively — business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.

opportunities.title: Route Optimization Service Integration (Incremental)
opportunities.rationale: Implement machine learning models to optimize existing sea and road freight routes based on real-time fuel costs and geopolitical factors. This leverages current data assets to improve operational efficiency without fundamentally changing the core service offering.

first_actions: Identify 3 key high-volume trade corridors for pilot optimization.
Allocate resources from the innovation fund to build a sandbox ML model.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average route transit time by 5% within Q3.
milestones: Full integration into operational dispatch system

opportunities.title: Specialized Cold Chain Logistics Platform (Radical)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a proprietary, end-to-end digital platform specializing in high-value perishable goods logistics, targeting the growing demand from biotech and premium food exporters. This represents diversification into a high-margin adjacent market.

first_actions: Conduct deep market analysis of biotech cold chain requirements.
Establish partnerships with 2 key specialized warehousing providers.
execution_plan.success_metric: Capture 1% of the identified high-value cold chain market share within 2 years.

next_steps.action: Conduct a formal feasibility study and ROI assessment for Route Optimization Service Integration.
Establish cross-functional steering committee dedicated to scoping the specialized Cold Chain Logistics Platform.

key_weaknesses: Reliance on formal decision-making, leading to potential bottlenecks and slow reaction times.
High organizational inertia which slows down the adoption of necessary technological shifts (e.g., adopting new AI tools).
Limited bandwidth due to a low budget percentage (4%), restricting large-scale radical diversification efforts.
Decentralized innovation structure leading to potential siloed effort and difficulty in scaling successful pilots.
